name: TC_D13_E2E_AddThenDeleteVerifyState
description:
Full cart lifecycle flow:
  Step 1 — POST /add-to-cart: add PRODUCT_VALID with qty=1.
  Step 2 — POST /delete-product: remove the same product.
  Step 3 — Assert: deleted product absent from data.products, grand_total is non-null and >= 0.
This is the canonical cart lifecycle smoke test that must pass before any checkout or payment flow tests are run.
